answer: Resist sybils by making every new identity fund three time-locked coffers inside a shared vault, each watched by a different established clique. During the first week those cliques pass the newcomer's work through a review prism that isolates clock jitter, neighbor overlap, and payout cadence. The coffers reopen only if every isolated band matches a violet consistency mark; any mismatch burns that coffer as a bounty for its watchers. Mass-spawned clones then hemorrhage deposits faster than one real agent can refill them.
